Chapter 7188: High Heaven’S Destruction

Chapter 7188: High Heaven’s Destruction

“Rumble!” An unknown power suddenly shook Heavenrealm. All worlds seemed to be one and beneath was a colossal monster waking up.

Lightning bolts appeared in all corners and crevices to everyone’s astonishment.

“Hide!” They saw the ominous signs but couldn’t run.

The bolts suspended vertically in the air, bursting forth with sparks and a blood-red radiance. They appeared to be alive.

“Up there!” An immortal pointed at the sky.

Everyone looked up and saw a vague figure, perhaps the shadow of the high heaven. However, a rising sun above the shadow was even more conspicuous. Its light was the blood-red radiance pulsing from the bolts - a sign of resonation.

“What is going on?” Immortals didn’t understand the sun’s significance.

“Boom!” Suddenly, the sun exploded in full force, waking immortals up to just how feeble they were.

After the sun exploded, a halo crossed through the sky toward the high heaven.

“Is it An Ran?” A primordial immortal asked.

“Bam!” They couldn’t see anything before a figure smashed against the sky barrier, falling back to the mortal world like a meteor.

“An Ran!” Duality Master shouted and saw that An Ran’s body resembled a broken vase: “You lost...”

The strongest immortals who still remembered him turned pale.

An Ran broke through the ocean of tribulations and defeated the avatar, earning the rights to fight the true body. Alas, he couldn’t block the high heaven’s dreadful attack.

“Rumble!” The tribulations descended once more to end An Ran.

“High Heaven’s Destruction.” Duality Master and the others understood.

The high heaven wanted to obliterate An Ran. Thus, it focused all of its tribulations to crush him.

“Selfless.” An Ran sighed and closed his eyes.

“Boom!” He self-imploded, destroying his body, mind, and all else. This created a countercurrent to meet the incoming tribulations, heaving them back to the sky.

Alas, this was only enough to push them back to the sky, unable to use them to kill their master. Once the countercurrent ran out, the tribulations descended again.

Now, all tribulations were descending in full force. This wave was like no other.

“Defend!” Empress Hong Tian gave the order.

Although they were afraid to see this apocalyptic wave, they had no choice but to face it. Their legs trembled but no one abandoned the Bulwark of Apocalypse.

Other immortals were moved and began joining. Apex Immortal and the others from Ancient burned their life force to aid Desolate Frontier.

“For our world, for future generations!” Chong Ming Lord used her true blood and true fate, shifting it to the purest original blood. The other divine beasts did the same.

“For our world!” The dragon servants and cultivators from Divine Firmament who once despised the divine beasts also offered their life force.

After all, everything would be buried after the calamity.

“The scale shall be upheld for ages, as long as the golden laws endure, so will all living beings.” Emperor Ye guided Golden World, offering everything they had to help Desolate Frontier.
